items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: And him and I, we were seat-mates on the bus.

ctx.x:
Yeah, Pops was somethin' great. And him and I, because I was the baby in the band and he was the old man... And him and I, we were seat-mates on the bus. And boy, he was something else. Pops was a great old man.
A funny thing. I seen Pops almost fifty years later, maybe not that many years but it seemed like it to me, and he was telling me... He passed by my house one day when I was looking out the window, I stopped him, and we got to talking. And he was telling me, he said, "You know..." At that time, he was…
